representation.new_text_gate_scope: Exact U+FEFF and line-end ASCII spaces/tabs inspected. Repository whitespace CI was not run.

acceptance_limitations: Job counts are not test counts and are not added to previous native counts.
A failed aggregate job is not a new independent root cause.
The merge-only runtime failure is not a head-source test failure; head runtime job metadata is success.
The earlier structure/closure/work-time/large-state/workspace-profile successes remain their own evidence and do not establish whole-repository green status.
This review establishes no ordinary A-to-C business loop, independent consumer C, positive adoption, or ordinary NoUpdateRollback.
